summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $2.9B+ accumulation in SPX 7000C (exp 2026-12-18) and significant call premiums in AMD and META. The dominant pattern is a massive, multi-day bet on the SPX 7000 strike through 2026 and 2027, suggesting institutions are building a "floor" via long-dated LEAPS. While there is notable hedging via SPX 8000P and 7880P, the sheer scale of the $700M+ individual SPX 7000C trades outweighs the downside protection. Traders should watch for continued strength in the SPX and tech leaders (NVDA, AMD, META) as the market tests the validity of this multi-billion dollar long-term call accumulation.
